messages:
michael_support: Heads up — Orchard Health trial is blocked on production token exchange during onboarding. Customers getting recurring 401s when exchanging the auth code. They've tried twice today and are frustrated. Renewal window in 18 days. Escalating to CS for priority handoff.

oncall-bot: New ticket created: #45678 (P1) — https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/45678 — metadata: product=redwood-api, severity=P1

elaine_csm: Thanks Michael. Adding to my queue. Can someone post a short timeline and who will own the technical fix? @sam_engineer? 🙏

sam_engineer: Looking into logs now. OAuth callback shows 403 from customer IdP for some token exchange requests. Hypothesis: client secret rotation on their side. I can push a temporary bypass to accept test tokens so onboarding can continue, but we need AM to confirm prod client id before prod deploy.

leo_account_manager: I just pinged the customer — they can access the dev client id but are waiting on security approval to share prod creds. I recommended a 45m enablement call to walk through the swap. Also flagging renewal risk: if onboarding stalls >72h, risk goes from low -> medium-high.

michael_support: Draft comms plan below — please review/edit. If we agree I'll send and book the call.

michael_support: ```Comms plan (proposed):
- T+0: acknowledge to customer, open P1, set expectation (we own it). Owner: elaine_csm
- T+1h: enablement call (CS + AM + Eng) to get prod client id and live test creds
- T+2h: eng pushes temporary acceptance patch to staging; confirm token exchange 200
- T+6h: with AM confirmation, deploy to prod and rotate credentials with customer
- T+24h: follow-up to confirm onboarding flow, capture success metrics
- Contingency: if unresolved at T+4h -> notify CSM director and exec sponsor; consider short-term credit if customer indicates commercial frustration
Escalation contact: sam_engineer (eng), leo_account_manager (AM), elaine_csm (CS)
```

elaine_csm: I can run the call at 15:00 PT today. I'll use the abbreviated enablement checklist and ask for screen share of the IdP flow. Drafting the message to send now.

michael_support: Sample blurb to send to customer (please copy/edit):

michael_support: "Hi Maya — thanks for flagging this. We're prioritizing onboarding and have a small cross-functional team standing by. Can you join a quick 45-minute call today at 15:00 PT to swap credentials and verify the token exchange? We're seeing 401s from the IdP; likely a client secret mismatch. We'll walk through a safe rotation path. — Michael, Support"

leo_account_manager: Sending that now and asking them to confirm 15:00 PT. Also preparing a short retention note for renewal team: if this completes today, we keep renewal on track; if not, escalate to 1:1 outreach.

sam_engineer: Quick update: pushed temp acceptance to staging; token exchange returns 200 for test client id. I will not push to prod until AM confirms client id from customer. Also capturing logs to the ticket.

michael_support: Noting commercial flag: customer mentioned they were evaluating alternatives during the stall. @leo_account_manager please coordinate a check-in with the renewal playbook if the call slips. :warning:

elaine_csm: Assigning owner in CS board -> task CS-812. I'll run the call, capture screenshots, and update playbook with the root cause + steps taken. After call I'll add a short success note we can include in renewal pack.

michael_support: Thanks team. After the call, please paste the verification steps into the ticket and add any follow-up actions. If we need to offer a short-term concession, let's ping director first.

sam_engineer: Post-call plan (if confirmed): 1) prod deploy of fix 2) creds rotate with customer 3) smoke test 4) mark ticket resolved and attach logs. ETA ~2h after call.

elaine_csm: Customer confirmed 15:00. I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + agenda. Sending pre-call checklist in thread after invite. :calendar:

michael_support: Perfect — marking this thread as P1 handoff to CS. Keep me looped for any customer messaging changes.

elaine_csm: Pre-call checklist: 1) customer share IdP screen, 2) AM confirm prod client id, 3) eng on call to run test token exchange, 4) decide go/no-go for prod deploy. I'll paste checklist into ticket.

leo_account_manager: Customer accepted invite. Preparing a brief renewal note for director in case we need to stretch SLA timeframe.

oncall-bot: Ticket #45678 updated: status=investigating, assignees=[elaine_csm, sam_engineer], priority=P1

elaine_csm: Call complete — we validated client id mismatch, rotated client secret, eng deployed to prod, smoke test passed. Customer is able to complete onboarding flow. Updating ticket with steps and closing loop. :white_check_mark:

michael_support: Awesome — thanks everyone. Please add a one-paragraph summary to the renewal sheet noting time to resolve and customer sentiment. That will help retention outreach.

elaine_csm: Summary posted to renewal sheet and CS board. Closing this handoff.
